environment.description: Same Django app deployed on EKS. A Vault Agent sidecar (injector v1.3.1) with template rendering writes MODEL_SIGNING_KEY to a tmpfs-mounted file that the app reads via django-environ's FileConfigLoader. The Vault secret engine is configured with a TTL of 60 seconds and max_ttl of 60 seconds on the 'ml-platform/model-signing' path. The app's FileConfigLoader polls the mounted secret file every 5 seconds via inotify watch. Authentication tokens are issued by the Vault transit backend with use_limit=1 and ttl=60s, distributed through the same sidecar injection. The Kubernetes ServiceAccount bound to the pod has a projected token volume with expirationSeconds=90 and audience restriction to 'vault'. Network policy (Calico GlobalNetworkPolicy 'deny-egress-except-vault') restricts pod egress to only the Vault cluster endpoint on port 8200.

config.auth_token_policy: use_limit=1, ttl=60s, issued per-request via transit backend
config.network_policy: Calico GlobalNetworkPolicy deny-egress-except-vault, allows only vault:8200
